name: Mariano Navone
intro: Mariano Navone is from a small city in Argentina. Fans call him La Navoneta. He is famous for his big smile and his dance moves.
story: Mariano grew up in Nueve de Julio. His city is famous for car racing. He started tennis at age three. His mom, dad and sister all play too! In April he won his first ATP title in Bucharest. Then in New York he beat the legend Novak Djokovic. It took five sets and more than four and a half hours. He called it a dream come true. Next time, watch for his dance!

funFacts.text: As a newborn baby, he got a rattle shaped like a tennis racket!
His hometown has a famous racetrack. His dad took him to car races as a kid.
He loves NBA basketball. He cheers for the soccer club Argentinos Juniors.
He loves to dance and do funny impressions of other athletes.
He likes to joke around with the ball kids during matches.
His nickname La Navoneta copies Argentina's soccer team nickname, La Scaloneta.
He beat Novak Djokovic in five sets at this year's US Open.

watchFor: Watch for his big grin and a little dance after a great point.

notes: Born 2001-02-27 Nueve de Julio, 178 cm, right-handed/2HBH, started tennis at three, Bucharest 2026 first ATP title over Merida, US Open R1 def. Djokovic 7-6(5) 5-7 4-6 6-2 6-1: confirmed on en.wikipedia.
